items: “Mod this game” in Tankōbon now opens the game's flowchart straight away. The modder works on Tankōbon's own game: nothing is copied, there is no second library, and every change is saved into Tankōbon at once as the Story edits mod on that game (no Send to Tankōbon needed). It uses Tankōbon's Ren'Py runtime too.
Games copied here by nodes-5.10 still have Send to Tankōbon, for edits made in them; they can be deleted.
Works inside Tankōbon's desktop app: there the modder opens in Tankōbon's window (its files still come from the website, so it keeps its own updates).
The modder is its own app now, on the Tankōbon website (modder/), with its own updates. It can be installed apart from Tankōbon.
Games come from Tankōbon: “Mod this game” on a game's page there opens the modder with the game handed over (no adding it again). A game already here only gets what is new, and your edits stay.
Send to Tankōbon: the Story edits made here go back to Tankōbon as a mod on that game, which can be switched off there.
